title: VR Bungee
description_html:
Price:

  • ₹500 per person
  • ₹800 for two people
Not a fan of dangling from dizzying heights but still crave the thrill of a breathtaking plunge? Dive into an exhilarating adventure like never before with Thrill Factory's VR Bungee Jump Flight Simulator, a perfect blend of cutting-edge technology and heart-pounding excitement. Imagine the thrill of bungee jumping combined with the magic of virtual reality, creating an immersive experience that will leave you awestruck. Whether you’re a thrill-seeker looking for an adrenaline rush or someone eager to explore new dimensions, this simulator is designed to deliver unforgettable moments.
Our VR Bungee offers an unparalleled adventure for two participants at a time. The experience begins with state-of-the-art DPVR E3C headsets, ensuring crystal-clear visuals and seamless virtual environments that transport you to breathtaking worlds. Paired with a powerful computing system, the simulator creates a smooth and immersive journey, blurring the lines between the virtual and real. To amplify the realism, synchronized wind effects respond dynamically to your movements, making every jump and flight feel extraordinarily lifelike.
Safety and comfort are at the heart of this experience. The VR Bungee is equipped with a vertical lifting soft seat, sturdy helical wire ropes, and robust construction, ensuring you can focus entirely on the adventure without a second thought. The simulator's ergonomic design guarantees comfort, even during high-energy movements, making it an ideal choice for individuals of all ages.
What sets this simulator apart is the variety of virtual environments it offers. You can choose from an exciting selection of scenarios, each crafted to transport you to a different world:
  • Adventures of Aladdin: Embark on a magical journey through the mystical world of Aladdin.
  • Under Water Adventures: Dive deep into the ocean and explore the wonders beneath the waves.
  • Great Wall Adventures: Soar above the iconic Great Wall, taking in breathtaking views.
  • Desert Canyons: Navigate through the vast and challenging terrains of desert canyons.
  • Forest Runner: Dash through dense forests, encountering wildlife and natural obstacles.
  • Desert Chasing: Engage in a high-speed chase across arid desert landscapes.
  • Exploration of the Planet: Embark on a global adventure, discovering diverse cultures and landmarks.
  • Jurassic Park: Travel back in time to the age of dinosaurs in this thrilling prehistoric adventure.
  • Ocean Adventure Roller: Experience the excitement of an underwater roller coaster ride.
  • Santa Claus: Join Santa on a festive journey through winter wonderlands.
  • Wild Man Roller Coaster: Brave the wildest roller coaster ride through untamed terrains.
  • Candy Land: Indulge in a sweet adventure through a world made entirely of candy.
  • Travelling around the World: Take a whirlwind tour of the world's most famous destinations.
  • Moby Dick: Set sail on a nautical quest inspired by the classic tale of Moby Dick. 
Each scenario promises a unique and captivating experience, ensuring there’s something for everyone. Whether you're looking to conquer fears, challenge yourself, or simply have fun, the VR Bungee caters to all kinds of adventurers.
Join us at Thrill Factory and step into a new dimension of excitement with our VR Bungee Jump Flight Simulator. From the breathtaking visuals to the adrenaline-pumping movements, this attraction is more than just a ride—it’s an unforgettable journey that will leave you wanting more. Ready to leap into the extraordinary? Plan your visit today and let the adventure begin!
  • Age: 10 years and above
  • Weight: 30 Kgs (Minimum) to 90 Kgs (Maximum) – To ensure that the harness fits properly
